capabilities: Create notes from a LeetCode link or problem number
Fetch problem metadata, description, and similar questions
Import accepted solutions into existing notes
Configure filename templates and target folder
Switch interface language between English and Russian
disambiguation: Not a static template pack; it fetches live problem data and solutions from LeetCode each time you create a note.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Login uses an embedded browser window with pasted cookies as a fallback; desktop only, Obsidian 1.5.0+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull LeetCode problem details and your accepted solutions into a structured note.
summary: LeetCode integration that creates structured notes from a problem link or number, fetching metadata, description, similar questions, and accepted solutions.
